ns2:section.sectionText: Leverage your accumulated knowledge with your natural abilities to solve problems for real-world clients. This section will open to BS: Inf Sys & Info Tech - UIUC and BS: Business Process Mgt - UIUC on Monday, April 17, 2017 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to BS: Finance - UIUC, BS: Accountancy - UIUC, MS: Finance Cost Rec - UIUC, MBA: (PT) Business Admin - UIUC, MS: Technology Management - UIUC and MBA: Bus Administration - UIUC on Monday, April 24, 2017 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to Industrial & Enterprise Systems Engineering students on Monday, May 1, 2017 at approximately 10:00 a.m.
